title: Document Sidecar Response Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating PDF render responses from the document sidecar service. Supports both success responses with base64-encoded PDF data and error responses with standardized error codes.

ErrorCode.description: Standardized error codes for the document sidecar API. VALIDATION_ERROR (400) indicates request payload validation failure. AUTH_FAILED (401) indicates invalid API key or HMAC signature. TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND (404) indicates unknown report type. RATE_LIMITED (429) indicates request rate exceeded. RENDER_FAILED (500) indicates PDF generation failure. INTERNAL_ERROR (500) indicates unexpected server error.

ErrorDetails.description: Optional object containing additional error context. Structure varies by error type - may include validation errors, stack traces in development mode, or other diagnostic information.

ErrorObject.description: Structured error information returned when a render request fails. Contains the error code, human-readable message, optional details, and optional request ID for correlation.

code.description: Machine-readable error code identifying the type of failure

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong

details.description: Optional additional error context and diagnostic information

request_id.description: Correlation ID from the original request for distributed tracing

ErrorResponse.description: Response envelope for failed render requests. The success field is always false, and the error field contains structured error information.

success.description: Always false for error responses, enabling easy discrimination from success responses

error.description: Structured error information describing the failure

RenderResultData.description: The actual render result data containing the generated PDF and metadata. Returned within a successful response envelope.

pdf_base64.description: Base64-encoded PDF document content. Decode using standard base64 decoder to obtain raw PDF bytes.

filename.description: Suggested filename for the generated PDF document, including the .pdf extension (e.g., 'INV-2024-001.pdf')

page_count.description: Number of pages in the generated PDF document. Always at least 1.

content_type.description: MIME type of the generated document. Always 'application/pdf' for current implementation.

render_time_ms.description: Time taken to render the PDF in milliseconds, measured from request receipt to PDF generation completion. Useful for performance monitoring.

RenderSuccessResponse.description: Response envelope for successful render requests. Contains the success flag, render result data, and the request correlation ID.

success.description: Always true for successful responses, enabling easy discrimination from error responses

data.description: The render result containing the PDF and associated metadata

request_id.description: Echo of the request_id from the original request for correlation and tracing
